name: io.github.tonyyang0504/moloco-mcp
description: Moloco Ads (ads): me, list_accounts, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a documented end

environmentVariables.name: PLATFORM_MCP_MOLOCO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Moloco Ads API key (Moloco Ads > account settings > API key; created for the ad account's workplace). Exchanged at POST https://api.moloco.cloud/cm/v1/auth/tokens {api_key} for a 16-hour bearer token, re-requested on expiry or 401.
